_readme: Calibration ledger for build-estimate. `records` are MEASURED runs — append one per finished build via `estimate.py calibrate`. `profiles` name the process a build runs under; a profile with no record scales from another by an ASSUMED multiplier and the tool says so. `task_kinds` and `task_status` are the unit scalars; each carries its basis. Canonical copy: ~/gits/clybor-claude-tooling/.claude/skills/build-estimate/calibration.json — promote after every calibrate.

intensive.description: build-execute loop: mandatory adversarial review on every iteration, mutation harness, per-iteration report, staged-then-landed with diff -rq. The high end of process cost.

standard.description: review per batch of tasks rather than per iteration; tests but no mutation harness; no per-iteration report.

light.description: no review loop; write, run the test, move on. Prototypes and throwaway scripts.

decision-doc.basis: settlement-verifier build: doc/tracker-only iterations (22, 32) ran ~half a task

test-layer.basis: settlement-verifier build: fixtures, assertions, comparator (Tasks 18, 50, 54) — the median task

check-logic.basis: settlement-verifier build: a verifier rule plus its fixtures (Tasks 34, 52) drew 2–3 review rounds

driver.basis: settlement-verifier build: shell driver with negative controls (Task 11); bash 3.2 and gate ordering cost a round

harness.basis: settlement-verifier build: mutation sections where each mutation names the flag it must raise (Task 41 scale)

extraction-ocr.basis: settlement-verifier build: every OCR/reading-order item (Task 14 reruns, extractor) overran and reversed a headline; low confidence

integration-run.basis: settlement-verifier build: a real-matter end-to-end run (extract on host, author record, check, read flags); environment unknowns

staged.basis: settlement-verifier build: with code staged and the suite green, review + repair + land was ~40% of an iteration

in-review.basis: review opened; repairs and landing remain

records.note: Iterations 14-36 of a 66-task plan, single operator (Shawn) driving build-execute with Claude Code. Every iteration ran mandatory adversarial review; most were BLOCKed at least once and repaired in-iteration. Tasks were verification-layer work (check logic, fixtures, comparators, harness) — no UI, no external integration. low = evening stretch of small test-layer tasks (iterations 20-24); high = Task 52 (three review rounds) and Task 34 (two iterations). Counted from iteration-report mtimes on 2026-08-28.
